messages:
rachel (partnerships): FYI KeyBridge (HW KMS + secrets provider) asked to go live in Redwood marketplace. they claim full HSM/FIPS support, SCIM, SSO (SAML + OIDC), plus a secret-sync adapter. they9d like a soft launch + joint webinar late July. who needs to own sign-off?

dan (security): Dan here. security sign-off items: HSM attestation + signed cert chain, FIPS validation doc, BYOK envelope flow that supports our rewrap API, tamper-evident audit trail, and a minimal threat-model for their adapter. also want a short SLA/assertion about key custody.

priya (product): Product: we need the marketplace metadata fields populated (features, limits, beta flags), vendor logo + 1-paragraph blurb, and a list of admin UI actions (connect, rotate keys, revoke). can we get vendor copy by EOD Fri?

kyle (eng): I can run an integration in staging. checklist from eng side: exercises for wrap/unwrap, rotation, secret-sync (create/update/delete), SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning, SAML login + OIDC flow, and audit event delivery. ask vendor for a minimal curl example and a test vector.

rachel (partnerships): vendor says they9ll provide assets by Thu and want a staging run next Wed afternoon. proposed embargo lift for joint marketing = 2027-07-30 00:00 PT. legal wants to review copy 48h before.

dan (security): Also add latency goals: median wrap <45ms; p99 <160ms in staging. require nonce-based replay protection and signed audit entries. if vendor manages wrapping keys on their side, contract must include indemnity + access controls.

kyle (eng): please ask them to prove a rewrap after rotation: we rotate wrapping key K1->K2 and confirm previously wrapped secrets decrypt correctly after rewrap. also ask for a tiny curl example we can run:

```
POST https://api.keybridge.example.com/v1/wrap
Authorization: Bearer <partner-token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "plaintext_dek_b64": "BASE64(32-byte-DEK)",
  "nonce_b64": "BASE64(nonce)"
}
```

expected response includes: `wrapped_key_b64`, `wrap_algo`, `key_id`, and `signature_b64` (HSM-signed).

priya (product): product will mark BYOK as "beta" until the rotation/rewrap test is green. also we9ll need UI copy explaining what BYOK means for customers and a checkbox during onboarding for "I understand keys are BYOK".

legal (legal): noted. legal review: export controls (crypto), data processing addendum alignment, and indemnity language if vendor retains wrap keys. embargo: we need final copy 48 hours prior to proposed lift.

rachel (partnerships): action items: 1) kyle/eng run staging with KeyBridge Wed 2pm PT 2) dan finalize security acceptance checklist by EOD Tue 3) legal to confirm embargo and export control screening (legal) 4) priya to draft marketplace listing and beta flags.

deploy-bot: provisioning queued: tenant kb-partner-stg-07. invite will be sent to contact keybridge@vendor.com. ephemeral creds expire in 72h. link: https://staging.console.redwood/tenants/kb-partner-stg-07

kyle (eng): will send calendar invite and paste results here after run. i9ll capture HAR + timing metrics and attach to this thread. please remind me if we need FIPS-level crypto validation steps.

dan (security): one more: confirm HSM firmware versions and attestation chain. if vendor uses multiple HSM models, we need a matrix of supported models.

rachel (partnerships): got it. i9ll collect vendor assets and confirm staging slot. planning note: vendor also pitched a short demo + customer Q&A; priya, should marketing expect to host webinar with us?

priya (product): yes, marketing will co-host if checklist green. set webinar tentative for week of Aug 2. marking for follow-up after staging run. :calendar:

kyle (eng): copied. preparing test harness now.

deploy-bot: keybridge@vendor.com added to tenant kb-partner-stg-07.
